shape: unit_sheet.json Công trình (drone_hangar, branch drone_hangar.lancet): the Lancet branch on the base's shelter (owner decision 4): a long catapult rail raised 15 degrees.

features.feature: front apron (the yard) with joints and tyre stains
earth berm over the vault, its rear end drawn in, sod bands, stones
concrete headwall with lift joints, Team band, sandbag crest, anchor bolts; angled wing walls
sandbag retaining courses along both feet and round the vents
roller door: slatted curtain, guides, drum housing, hazard edge, wicket, lamp
berm fittings: two mushroom vents, ladder up the flank, whip antenna and radio box
yard: charging bench under a canvas lean-to, generator with exhaust, tool chest
drone crates and fuel drum under a camouflage net on poles, floodlight, rear wire fence
railed steel platform on the crown on legs
Team catapult rail on a truss, air bottle, compressor and hose
a Lancet (cruciform X-wings, pusher prop) on the shuttle, Lancet boxes

weapons.note: root pivots (no turret): Muzzle_door_l and Muzzle_main at the launch point (kept)

budget.note: owner decision 6 (wave 1): a tower is seen in numbers, at most 1.5 x the class maximum
